bio: I am responsible in helping students navigate their academic path within Harvard using all of the University's resources. I handle all recommendation letters, House letters, and any other confidential material. I also organize events to bring the community together. In my spare time, I love to cook, read, and travel. I love to do these things alone or with my village. Community Dudley Community Area Residential Life Role Residential Academic Coordinators
